title: Injury log
tip.page:
Tapping "Pain" or "Stopped" on an activity opens a record automatically (a draft); fill in the details here.
When it's better, press "Healed". If the same area hurts again after that, a new record opens; one within 42 days of the last "Healed" is marked "Recurrence" (estimate).
The data stays on this computer only: it isn't synced and never appears in a share link.
tl.title: Timeline
tl.tip:
Grey bars = each week's volume (switchable), line = Chronic load.
Coloured bands = injury and illness periods: the colour is the area, darker = more severe; hatched = not healed yet.
The ticks below = "Sore" (yellow) and "Pain / Stopped" (red) taps on activities, so you can see whether soreness came several times before the pain.
The thin ACWR line is for reference only; it doesn't predict injuries (Lövdal 2021).
list.title: Records
list.draft_hint: Yellow border = draft: it goes into the analysis once its details are filled in
list.empty2: After a run, tap "Pain" in the activity list or on a single activity's charts, or press "+ Add" at the top right.
card.recur_tip: Same area, within 42 days of the last one healing
ev.head: {label} · the 21 days before the injury
ev.legend: Bars = running minutes per day, line = descent

ev.acute: Acute injuries are not compared by load
ev.none: This record is not in the analysis (see the analysis section's help)
an.title: Before an injury vs usual
an.tip:
The 21 days before each injury (not counting the day the pain started), compared with your own 21-day stretches at other times (one every 7 days; stretches within 28 days of an injury, from an injury until 42 days after it healed, or with too little training are left out).
Grey band = the middle half of usual (P25–P75), thin line = P10–P90, vertical line = median. Coloured dots = each injury (colour = area); the further right, the higher it was before the injury.
With fewer than 5 injuries only the dots are drawn, no statistics; 5–14 adds "median percentile, how many above the median"; only 15 or more adds the OR (exploratory).
"Higher than usual" = the 75th percentile or above (estimate). Acute injuries (falls, sprains), drafts and recurrences are left out.
an.season_tip: Compare only with usual stretches from the same season (± 3 months), to leave out summer and race-season differences
an.caution: One person and only a few injuries: this can hint at whether it's chance or a pattern, but it can't prove a cause. Estimate.
an.calc: Calculating… (the first time reads every activity)
an.pending: {n} {n|activity|activities} still to read second by second (steep downhill, cadence…); reload for a more complete picture
an.empty2: After a run tap "Pain", fill in the details here (area, severity) and press "Healed" when it's over; from 1 injury on, the dots before the injury are drawn.
an.not_enough_tip: Not enough data (< 60% of the stretches have a value)
adv.title: Advanced settings
adv.pattern_tip:
When on: if a measure over these 3 weeks (including the next 7 days of the schedule) looks like the pattern before your injuries, a reminder appears in the suggestions box.
It's only a reminder: it doesn't change the schedule or block a session. It can be turned on once at least 5 injuries are in the analysis. ACWR and monotony never trigger it.
adv.step_up: Recovery period one level up after an injury
adv.step_up_tip: When a break from running overlaps an injury log record, the recovery period uses the next level up (e.g. 10 days off uses the 14–28-day level): coming back from an injury, it's not only fitness — the tissues haven't adapted yet either (estimate).
adv.need: Needs at least {need} injuries in the analysis before it can be turned on (now {n})
disclaimer: This is not a medical diagnosis. For pain that persists or gets worse, see a doctor or physical therapist.
f.sev_tip: Graded by the effect on training: Mild = train as usual, Moderate = cut back or cross-train, Severe = stop running (an estimated grading).
f.pause_tip: When ticked, the schedule plans no intervals until this record is healed (every week, every phase). Unticked by default: training on with "Mild" pain is normal.
f.note_ex_injury: e.g. outside of the right knee on downhills; saw a rehab doctor
f.note_ex_illness: e.g. fever up to 38.5; saw a family doctor
f.area_rm_confirm: Remove "{a}" from the area list? Records already logged stay as they are.
f.need_illness: Pick one: a mild cold, or fever / whole-body symptoms
f.del_confirm: Delete injury log record #{id}? The pain marks on activities stay.
